description: Fetch a web page server-side and convert it to clean markdown — headings, links, lists, tables and text, with scripts, styles and boilerplate stripped. The 'reader' pattern agents use to actually understand web pages. SSRF-guarded with redirects re-validated, 10s timeout, 1MB cap. Use this when an agent needs to fetch any page and get clean markdown an LLM can read. x402 price $0.005/call (USDC, eip155:8453).
name: dev_url_reader
title: URL Reader (Markdown)
